item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-28
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen exciting progress recently, with notable updates in the scienceverse/metacheck and marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing projects. In scienceverse/metacheck, the team has made significant changes to the `data_check` branch, including the addition of a RO-crate metadata file and the removal of the full preview from the archive, which will improve data management and sharing. Meanwhile, the marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing project has seen updates to both its `gh-pages` and `master` branches, with a new site build for version 0.4.1 and a refinement to the success alert title in the `sweet_alert.js` file. These updates demonstrate the connections between our projects, with a focus on improving research tools and infrastructure. Overall, it's great to see our community actively maintaining and enhancing these important projects, and we look forward to seeing the impact of these changes on our research endeavors.

6 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
